evidence.evidence_text: Large language models (LLMs) that have been trained on multilingual but not parallel text exhibit a remarkable ability to translate between languages.
Large language models (LLMs) that have been trained on multilingual but not parallel text exhibit a remarkable ability to translate between languages.
We probe this ability in an in-depth study of the pathways language model (PaLM), which has demonstrated the strongest machine translation (MT) performance among similarly-trained LLMs to date.
